description: Multiplex network agent-based simulation of mask-wearing behavior diffusion with logistic state-updates driven by persistence, information exposure, peer influence by layer, individual risk perception, and a government intervention starting Day 10.

behaviors.name: ReceiveInformation
behaviors.description: Agents receive exogenous information events and optional neighbor-driven info, with boosts after government intervention.
behaviors.algorithm: For each agent i: p_info = lambda_info_base; if current_day >= intervention_day then p_info *= info_rate_multiplier. Optional: If neighbor_info_prob > 0, increase p_info by neighbor_info_prob * fraction_of_informed_neighbors_prev. Draw received_info_today ~ Bernoulli(p_info). Set received_info_lag1 = 1 if agent received info on previous day else 0.

behaviors.name: ComputePeerExposure
behaviors.description: Compute fraction of masked neighbors per network layer using previous-day states.
behaviors.algorithm: For each layer l in {family, work_school, community}, compute frac_masked_l = (# of neighbors in layer l with mask_state_prev == 1) / (degree in layer l; define 0 if degree=0). Optionally cap influence by daily_contacts per layer. Store per-layer fractions and a weighted exposure = sum_l (layer_weights[l] * frac_masked_l).

behaviors.name: UpdateMaskState
behaviors.description: Logistic adoption/continuation decision with persistence, exogenous info effects, peer influence by layer, and individual risk perception.
behaviors.algorithm: For agent i at day t: Compute linear predictor z = alpha + rho_persistence * mask_state_prev + beta_info_0 * received_info_today + beta_info_1 * received_info_lag1 + beta_family * frac_masked_family + beta_work_school * frac_masked_work_school + beta_community * frac_masked_community + beta_risk * risk_perception + gamma_demographics' * X_i. If day >= intervention_day then z += mandate_additive_logit. Convert to probability p = 1 / (1 + exp(-z)). Sample mask_state ~ Bernoulli(p). Optionally implement explicit abandonment hazard: if mask_state_prev == 1, reduce abandonment probability by abandonment_reduction.

behaviors.name: ShareInformationOptional
behaviors.description: Optional social info transmission mechanism from masked neighbors to unmasked agents.
behaviors.algorithm: If enabled: For unmasked agents, probability to receive_info increases by p_share_if_masked * fraction_masked_neighbors_all.

behaviors.name: BroadcastCampaign
behaviors.description: Government policy elevates information exposure and/or shifts adoption propensity after Day 10.
behaviors.algorithm: At start of each day: if current_day >= intervention_day then set global info multipliers and additive logit shifts accessible by agents' UpdateMaskState and ReceiveInformation.

behaviors.name: RecordDailyMetrics
behaviors.description: Collect prevalence, transition rates, and spell-length statistics.
behaviors.algorithm: After all agents update: prevalence_t = mean(mask_state). adoption_rate_t = # {mask_state_prev=0 and mask_state=1} / # {mask_state_prev=0}. abandonment_rate_t = # {mask_state_prev=1 and mask_state=0} / # {mask_state_prev=1}. Update wearing spell lengths for agents currently in wearing spells. Store stratified prevalence by age_group and occupation.

interactions.name: PeerInfluenceByLayer
interactions.description: Agents influence each other's adoption through layer-specific masked neighbor fractions computed from previous-day states.
interactions.effect: Modulates adoption probability via beta_family, beta_work_school, beta_community coefficients.

interactions.name: InformationExposure
interactions.description: Agents receive exogenous information; optional neighbor-originating information.
interactions.effect: Increases adoption probability through beta_info coefficients; may also decrease abandonment indirectly.

interactions.name: GovernmentIntervention
interactions.description: Policy intervention starting Day 10 alters info rates and/or adoption log-odds.
interactions.effect: Multiplies info arrival rate, adds to adoption logit, and can reduce abandonment.

steps: Load agent_attributes.csv; validate degrees and ranges.
Load train_data.csv; construct panel with day 0..29; set each agent's mask_state at day 0.

If social_network.json exists: ingest multiplex adjacency; compute reciprocity per layer; symmetrize family; decide directionality for other layers based on reciprocity threshold (e.g., if reciprocity < 0.4 keep directed). If no network, generate per-layer configuration-model graphs matching degree targets and homophily by age_group and occupation.
Merge attributes with time series; ensure one row per (agent,day); compute mask_state_prev and info lags.
Stage 1 calibration: fit logistic model without peer terms to estimate alpha, rho_persistence, beta_info_0, beta_info_1, beta_risk, and optional demographics.

If network available: augment regression with lagged peer exposure per layer to estimate beta_family, beta_work_school, beta_community. Else Stage 2: simulation-based calibration (SMM/ABC) to fit peer coefficients and layer weights to match prevalence and transition moments.
Fit lambda_info_base from received_info frequency in training data.
Optionally fit abandonment-specific hazard from wearing to not-wearing transitions and map into rho/alpha adjustments.
Set policy parameters; validate intervention starts at Day 10.

algorithms.SimulationLoop: For day t in 0..T-1: 1) For all agents, set mask_state_prev = mask_state. 2) GovernmentIntervention: update global policy effects if t >= intervention_day. 3) ReceiveInformation for all agents. 4) ComputePeerExposure for all agents using states at t. 5) UpdateMaskState for all agents synchronously to obtain states at t+1. 6) RecordDailyMetrics.
algorithms.LogisticUpdate: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(alpha + rho*mask_prev + beta_info_0*info_t + beta_info_1*info_{t-1} + sum_l beta_l*frac_masked_l + beta_risk*risk + gamma*X + mandate_shift))). Sample Bernoulli(p).
algorithms.NetworkGeneration: If needed, build each layer via configuration model with degree sequence from attributes; enforce even sum of degrees; apply homophily mixing matrices by age_group and occupation; add triadic closure to match clustering if specified.
algorithms.PeerExposureComputation: For each layer and agent, compute masked fraction from previous-day neighbor states; handle zero-degree safely.
algorithms.CalibrationStage1: Logistic regression or mixed-effects: mask_t ~ mask_{t-1} + received_info_t + received_info_{t-1} + risk_perception + demographics.
algorithms.CalibrationStage2: If network available: logistic with peer fractions. Else SMM/ABC: sample beta_family/work/community and layer_weights; simulate days 0..29; minimize distance between observed and simulated moments (prevalence path, adoption/abandonment rates, spell-length distribution).
algorithms.Evaluation: Using held-out days 30..39, compute RMSE of prevalence, Peak Adoption Rate Error, and Time-to-Peak Error against observed if available.
